summary_1line: Victor delays creating the female creature, agrees to travel to England with Clerval, and journeys down the Rhine toward London while burdened by dread.

image_candidates.scene_text: Victor lies in the bottom of a small boat on the Rhine, staring up at a cloudless blue sky while ruined castles and vineyards pass along the riverbanks.
Clerval stands in the boat pointing excitedly at castles and vineyards along the Rhine while the dark river winds between steep hills.
On a clear winter morning, Victor first sees the white cliffs of Britain rising above the sea as the ship approaches the Thames.
